Implement a module named barrel_shifter_8bit — an 8-bit barrel shifter that can
shift left or right by 0 to 7 positions in a single combinational step.

Interface:
  - input  [7:0] data_in
  - input  [2:0] shamt      (shift amount, 0 to 7)
  - input        dir        (direction: 0 = shift left, 1 = shift right)
  - input        arith      (1 = arithmetic shift, only meaningful when dir = 1)
  - output [7:0] data_out

Behaviour:
  - dir = 0                  data_out = data_in shifted LEFT by shamt, zero filled.
                             arith is ignored in this case.
  - dir = 1 and arith = 0    data_out = data_in shifted RIGHT by shamt, zero filled
                             (logical right shift).
  - dir = 1 and arith = 1    data_out = data_in shifted RIGHT by shamt with the
                             sign bit data_in[7] replicated into the vacated
                             positions (arithmetic right shift).

A shift amount of 0 leaves data_in unchanged in every mode.

This is a purely combinational circuit.
